messages.subject: Interactive decision tree in shiny
parts:
Dear All,

Is there any way where we can plot a decision tree in shiny which is highly interactive i.e. at the node level i should be able to select the split and than the tree should grow by one level? Also i need to control the nodes at each level to do some functionalities like assign a color to the node.

I see that there are some tools available like d3.js tree or DiagrammeR, but how to use it in shiny application is what baffling me.
